title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A1–B1）
section: 第 801–850 個單字（CEFR A1 基礎入門）

examples.en: The shop clerk greeted every customer with a smile.
examples.zh: 店員面帶微笑向每一位顧客打招呼。

examples.en: Dogs wag their tails excitedly to greet their owners coming home.
examples.zh: 狗狗興奮地搖尾巴迎接回家的主人。

examples.en: In many cultures, bowing is a traditional way to greet elders politely.
examples.zh: 在許多文化中，鞠躬是向長輩禮貌致意的傳統方式。

examples.en: A warm smile makes people feel welcome.
examples.zh: 溫暖的微笑能讓人感到賓至如歸。

examples.en: She smiled cheerfully upon seeing the unexpected birthday bouquet.
examples.zh: 看見意想不到的生日花束時，她開心地笑了。

examples.en: Keep smiling even when you encounter unexpected obstacles.
examples.zh: 即使遇到意想不到的挫折，也要保持微笑與樂觀。

examples.en: The hilarious sitcom made the entire class laugh.
examples.zh: 這部搞笑情境喜劇逗得全班哄堂大笑。

examples.en: It feels wonderful to sit together and laugh with lifelong friends.
examples.zh: 和相交一生的摯友圍坐在一起開懷大笑感覺無比美好。

examples.en: Laughter is often described as the best medicine for relieving daily stress.
examples.zh: 笑聲常被譽為緩解日常壓力的最佳良藥。

examples.en: The touching movie scene made her cry.
examples.zh: 那個感人的電影場景讓她哭了。

examples.en: The lost little boy started to cry and called out for his mother.
examples.zh: 迷路的小男孩開始哭泣，大聲呼喊著媽媽。

examples.en: A loud cry for help echoed through the quiet midnight street.
examples.zh: 一聲響亮的呼救聲在寧靜的午夜街道上迴盪。

examples.en: Please don't shout in the library hallway.
examples.zh: 請不要在圖書館走廊上大聲喊叫。

examples.en: Fans shouted with wild excitement when the winning goal was scored.
examples.zh: 當打進致勝球的那一刻，球迷們欣喜若狂地高聲吶喊。

examples.en: He had to shout over the roar of the rushing waterfall to be heard.
examples.zh: 他不得不蓋過奔騰瀑布的轟鳴聲大聲喊話才能讓別人聽見。

examples.en: She whispered the answer softly into my ear.
examples.zh: 她輕聲在我耳邊低語告訴我答案。

examples.en: The students whispered quietly in the back row during the quiet study hour.
examples.zh: 自習課時學生們在後排輕聲低語說著悄悄話。

examples.en: The pine trees seemed to whisper in the gentle autumn evening breeze.
examples.zh: 松樹彷彿在秋日傍晚的徐徐微風中輕聲絮語。

examples.en: I totally agree with your environmental proposal.
examples.zh: 我完全贊同你的環保提議。

examples.en: After a fruitful discussion, both sides agreed to sign the cooperation agreement.
examples.zh: 經過卓有成效的討論後，雙方同意簽署合作協議。

examples.en: We all agree that safety must always be our highest priority.
examples.zh: 我們大家一致同意安全必須永遠是我們的最高原則。

examples.en: It is okay to disagree politely during discussions.
examples.zh: 討論時抱持不同意見並禮貌表達是沒關係的。

examples.en: They often disagree on politics but remain very close friends.
examples.zh: 他們在政治立場上經常意見相左，但依然是親密的好朋友。

examples.en: I respectfully disagree with the claim that technology replaces human empathy.
examples.zh: 對於科技會取代人類同理心的說法，我抱持不同的見解。

examples.en: I promise to return your book by Friday.
examples.zh: 我保證在週五前歸還你的書。

examples.en: A person of integrity always strives to keep every promise made.
examples.zh: 一個有誠信的人總是努力恪守許下的每一項承諾。

examples.en: The talented young violinist shows great artistic promise for the future.
examples.zh: 這位富有天賦的年輕小提琴家展現了光明遠大的藝術前程。

examples.en: Ken invited all his classmates to his birthday party.
examples.zh: 肯恩邀請了全班同學參加他的生日聚會。

examples.en: The school invited a renowned marine biologist to deliver a guest lecture.
examples.zh: 學校邀請了一位著名的海洋生物學家前來進行專題演講。

examples.en: Leaving open food on kitchen counters invites troublesome ants and flies.
examples.zh: 將食物裸露放在廚房流理台上會招引討厭的螞蟻與蒼蠅。

examples.en: Thank you for the wedding invitation card!
examples.zh: 感謝你的婚禮喜帖邀請函！

examples.en: She graciously accepted the formal invitation to keynote the international conference.
examples.zh: 她欣然接受了在國際會議上發表主題演講的正式邀請。

examples.en: Send out party invitations at least two weeks ahead of time.
examples.zh: 請至少提前兩週發出派對的邀請函。

examples.en: Let me introduce my new classmate, David.
examples.zh: 讓我來介紹我的新同班同學，大衛。

examples.en: Please take two minutes to introduce yourself to the interview panel.
examples.zh: 請花兩分鐘時間向面試官小組做自我介紹。

examples.en: The tech company plans to introduce innovative eco-friendly products next quarter.
examples.zh: 這家科技公司計劃於下季度推出創新的環保產品。

examples.en: Remember to turn off the lights before leaving.
examples.zh: 離開前記得要關燈。

examples.en: I still clearly remember the first time I traveled abroad with my family.
examples.zh: 我依然清晰記得第一次和家人出國旅遊的情景。

examples.en: Please remember me warmly to your lovely parents when you visit home.
examples.zh: 你回家探親時請代我向你親愛的雙親致上由衷的問候。

examples.en: Don't forget to bring your umbrella today.
examples.zh: 今天出門別忘了帶雨傘。

examples.en: I will never forget the breathtaking sunrise we saw on Alishan.
examples.zh: 我永遠不會忘記我們在阿里山看見那令人屏息的壯美日出。

examples.en: He wrote down the important appointment details so he wouldn't forget them.
examples.zh: 他把重要預約細節寫下來，以免自己遺忘。

examples.en: Do you understand what the teacher explained?
examples.zh: 你明白老師剛剛解釋的內容了嗎？

examples.en: Practice speaking English regularly so you can make yourself understood clearly.
examples.zh: 經常練習說英語，這樣你才能讓別人清楚理解你的意思。

examples.en: True empathy means striving to understand someone else's feelings.
examples.zh: 真正的同理心意味著努力設身處地去理解他人的感受。

examples.en: What does this new English vocabulary word mean?
examples.zh: 這個新英文單字是什麼意思？

examples.en: I am so sorry; I didn't mean to hurt your feelings.
examples.zh: 非常抱歉，我絕不是有意要傷害你的感情。

examples.en: It was unkind and mean of him to tease the younger child.
examples.zh: 他去取笑年紀較小的孩子是很刻薄且不友善的行為。

examples.en: Look up the meaning of the word in a dictionary.
examples.zh: 在字典裡查詢這個單字的意思。

examples.en: Serving underprivileged communities gave deep meaning and purpose to her life.
examples.zh: 為弱勢社區服務為她的生命賦予了深遠的意義與目標。

examples.en: The true meaning of friendship is being there through both happiness and hardships.
examples.zh: 友誼的真諦是在順境與逆境中都常伴左右。

examples.en: That sounds like a wonderful idea for the weekend!
examples.zh: 這聽起來是個超棒的週末點子！

examples.en: Brainstorming meetings encourage team members to propose innovative ideas freely.
examples.zh: 腦力激盪會議鼓勵團隊成員自由提出創新的想法。

examples.en: I have no idea where I misplaced my car keys this morning.
examples.zh: 我完全不知道今天早上把車鑰匙落在何處了。

examples.en: No problem! I am always glad to help you.
examples.zh: 沒問題！我很樂意幫你的忙。

examples.en: Engineers worked tirelessly overnight to solve the technical network problem.
examples.zh: 工程師們整夜不眠不休地工作以解決網路技術難題。

examples.en: Climate change is a global problem requiring worldwide international collaboration.
examples.zh: 氣候變遷是需要全球各國攜手合作應對的世界級難題。

examples.en: Ask the teacher for help if you get into trouble.
examples.zh: 如果遇到麻煩，請向老師求助。

examples.en: She had trouble falling asleep because of the loud thunderstorm outside.
examples.zh: 因為外面的雷雨交加，她翻來覆去難以入睡。

examples.en: I am sorry to trouble you, but could you tell me the way to the subway?
examples.zh: 不好意思麻煩你，請問你可以告訴我前往捷運站的路嗎？

examples.en: What is the main reason for your school absence?
examples.zh: 你請假沒來上學的主要原因是什麼？

examples.en: For this reason, doctors strongly recommend washing hands regularly.
examples.zh: 基於這個原因，醫生強烈建議必須勤加洗手。

examples.en: He gave a logical, convincing reason for adjusting the project timeline.
examples.zh: 他為調整專案時程表提出了合乎邏輯且令人信服的理由。

examples.en: Hard work brings positive exam results.
examples.zh: 努力付出會帶來良好的考試成果。

examples.en: Heavy torrential rain caused flash flooding as a result of poor drainage.
examples.zh: 由於排水不良，豪大雨最終導致了瞬間積淹水的結果。

examples.en: The clinical experiment produced unexpected scientific results that surprised researchers.
examples.zh: 這項臨床實驗產生了令研究人員大感意外的科學成果。

examples.en: We wished our school team great success.
examples.zh: 我們祝福校隊獲得巨大的成功。

examples.en: Persistence, discipline, and passion are crucial keys to lasting success.
examples.zh: 堅持、自律與熱忱是通往持久成功的關鍵要素。

examples.en: The charity fundraising gala was an overwhelming commercial and social success.
examples.zh: 這場慈善募款晚會在商業與社會層面上皆獲得了空前的巨大成功。

examples.en: Follow your dream and never give up easily.
examples.zh: 追隨你的夢想，絕不要輕言放棄。

examples.en: I had a strange and vivid dream about flying across towering mountain ranges.
examples.zh: 我做了一個奇特且栩栩如生的夢，夢見自己在高聳的山脈上空翱翔。

examples.en: She dreams of traveling around the globe after completing her degree.
examples.zh: 她夢想著在取得學位後能踏上環遊世界的旅程。

examples.en: Can you keep a secret between the two of us?
examples.zh: 你能保守我們兩人之間的秘密嗎？

examples.en: The chef refuses to reveal the secret ingredient behind the award-winning sauce.
examples.zh: 主廚拒絕透露這款獲獎特調醬汁背後的獨門秘密食材。

examples.en: Government intelligence archives keep top-secret files protected under high security.
examples.zh: 政府情報檔案庫在高度嚴密戒備下保管著絕密機密文件。

examples.en: The birthday gift was a delightful surprise.
examples.zh: 這份生日禮物是一個令人愉悅的驚喜。

examples.en: Much to our pleasant surprise, the weather cleared up right before the picnic.
examples.zh: 讓我們非常驚喜的是，天氣在野餐開始前恰好放晴了。

examples.en: We organized a memorable surprise party to celebrate our teacher's retirement.
examples.zh: 我們精心籌辦了一場難忘的驚喜派對來慶祝老師光榮退休。

examples.en: Everyone hopes for lasting world peace.
examples.zh: 每個人都期盼持久的世界和平。

examples.en: Sitting quietly by the serene mountain lake brought deep inner peace.
examples.zh: 靜坐在寧靜的高山湖畔帶來了心靈深處的祥和與平靜。

examples.en: I cherish the peace and quiet of early mornings before the city awakens.
examples.zh: 我非常珍惜在城市甦醒前清晨特有的安寧與靜謐。

examples.en: Traffic noise outside kept me awake last night.
examples.zh: 外面的車輛噪音讓我昨晚睡不著。

examples.en: Please refrain from making loud noise while studying in the quiet reading room.
examples.zh: 在安靜的閱覽室內讀書時請勿發出吵鬧的噪音。

examples.en: The car began making an alarming metallic noise whenever braking.
examples.zh: 這輛汽車每當煞車時就開始發出一種令人不安的金屬異音。

examples.en: That idea sounds exciting and creative!
examples.zh: 那個點子聽起來刺激又有創意！

examples.en: The calming sound of ocean waves lapping against the shore helped me relax.
examples.zh: 海浪輕輕拍打海岸的舒緩聲音幫助我放鬆身心。

examples.en: Despite the storm, the sturdy wooden cabin remained structurally sound.
examples.zh: 儘管經歷了暴風雨，這座堅固的木屋結構依然完好無損。

examples.en: The singer has a sweet and melodious voice.
examples.zh: 這位歌手擁有一副甜美悅耳的好歌喉。

examples.en: Please lower your voice because patients in the ward are resting.
examples.zh: 病房裡的病患正在休息，請壓低你的說話音量。

examples.en: Citizens have every right to raise their voice against unfair community policies.
examples.zh: 公民完全有權利發出聲音反對不合理的社區政策。

examples.en: Reading every day is an excellent habit to build.
examples.zh: 每天閱讀是值得培養的極佳習慣。

examples.en: It takes deliberate daily practice to break a bad habit like staying up late.
examples.zh: 需要持之以恆的每日實踐才能戒除像熬夜這樣的壞習慣。

examples.en: Drinking a glass of warm water upon waking is a healthy morning habit.
examples.zh: 早晨起床後喝一杯溫開水是一項健康的晨間習慣。

examples.en: What are your plans for the summer vacation?
examples.zh: 你的暑假有什麼計畫？

examples.en: We made a detailed emergency evacuation plan in case of natural disasters.
examples.zh: 我們制定了一份詳細的緊急疏散計畫以防發生天然災害。

examples.en: The architect presented a comprehensive floor plan for the new community library.
examples.zh: 建築師展示了新社區圖書館的全面平面規劃設計圖。

examples.en: Set clear study goals at the beginning of each semester.
examples.zh: 每個學期初設定明確的讀書目標。

examples.en: The star soccer forward scored an astonishing goal in the final seconds.
examples.zh: 明星足球前鋒在最後幾秒攻進了一記驚艷全場的關鍵進球。

examples.en: Breaking down long-term dreams into smaller milestones makes goals achievable.
examples.zh: 將遠大夢想拆解為各個階段性小目標會使目標更容易達成。

examples.en: Students must follow the school and library rules.
examples.zh: 學生必須遵守學校和圖書館的規定。

examples.en: The golden rule of good friendship is treating others as you wish to be treated.
examples.zh: 深厚友誼的黃金法則就是以你希望被對待的方式去對待他人。

examples.en: The wise emperor ruled the ancient prosperous empire justly for forty years.
examples.zh: 英明的君主公正仁慈地統治了這座繁榮古帝國長達四十年。

examples.en: Everyone must obey traffic safety laws.
examples.zh: 每個人都必須遵守交通安全法規。

examples.en: Isaac Newton formulated universal scientific laws explaining gravity and motion.
examples.zh: 艾薩克·牛頓創立了闡釋萬有引力與物體運動的普遍科學定律。

examples.en: She studied constitutional law at university to become a public interest attorney.
examples.zh: 她在大學研讀憲法，志在成為一名維護公眾利益的人權律師。

examples.en: Are you ready to order your lunch now?
examples.zh: 請問你現在準備好要點午餐了嗎？

examples.en: Please arrange all historical documents in chronological order.
examples.zh: 請依照時間先後順序整齊排列所有歷史文獻檔案。

examples.en: The police officer issued a strict order commanding spectators to remain behind barricades.
examples.zh: 警官下達了嚴格指令，命令圍觀群眾留在防護欄後方。

examples.en: A large crowd gathered to watch the live concert.
examples.zh: 一大群民眾聚集觀賞現場演唱會。

examples.en: Festive holiday crowds poured into the bustling department stores for sales.
examples.zh: 洋溢節慶歡樂的人潮湧入熱鬧的百貨公司搶購特賣商品。

examples.en: Avoid walking alone into chaotic and uncontrolled street crowds.
examples.zh: 避免隻身走入混亂且缺乏管制的街頭人群之中。

examples.en: We worked in small groups for the science project.
examples.zh: 我們在自然科學專題中分組合作。

examples.en: Our class set up a dedicated LINE discussion group for sharing study notes.
examples.zh: 我們班設立了一個專門的 LINE 討論群組以分享讀書筆記。

examples.en: A group of wild dolphins leaped playfully alongside the scenic whale-watching ferry.
examples.zh: 一群野生海豚在風景優美的賞鯨渡輪旁歡快地躍出水面。

examples.en: I joined the English speaking club this semester.
examples.zh: 我這學期加入了英語演講社。

examples.en: The high school robotics club designed a prize-winning automated machine.
examples.zh: 高中機器人社團設計出了一部榮獲大獎的自動化機器設備。

examples.en: Golfers select the appropriate golf club according to the distance to the hole.
examples.zh: 高爾夫球手會根據與球洞的距離選取適當的球桿。

examples.en: There are five members in my project group.
examples.zh: 我的專題小組有五位成員。

examples.en: Gym members enjoy unlimited access to swimming facilities and fitness classes.
examples.zh: 健身房會員享有無限次使用游泳設施與健身課程的權益。

examples.en: Every family member gathered around the dining table for the reunion dinner.
examples.zh: 每位家庭成員都圍坐在餐桌旁享用溫馨的除夕團圓飯。

examples.en: She is the team leader for our science project.
examples.zh: 她是我們自然科學專題的小組隊長。

examples.en: A visionary leader inspires colleagues to innovate, persevere, and excel.
examples.zh: 一位富有遠見的領袖能激勵同仁勇於創新、堅持不懈並追求卓越。

examples.en: Taiwan is recognized as a global industry leader in cutting-edge microchips.
examples.zh: 台灣被公認為尖端晶片製造領域的全球產業領頭羊。

examples.en: Practice the dialogue with your seat partner.
examples.zh: 和你的鄰座搭檔一起練習對話。

examples.en: They established a successful business and have been trusted partners for decades.
examples.zh: 他們創立了一番成功的事業，數十年來一直是互信互惠的合作夥伴。

examples.en: Dancing the salsa smoothly requires coordinated rhythm between both dance partners.
examples.zh: 跳出流暢動人的騷莎舞需要雙方舞伴之間協調默契的節拍配合。

examples.en: We prepared a warm welcome for our dinner guests.
examples.zh: 我們為晚餐賓客準備了熱情的款待。

examples.en: The luxury resort offers complimentary breakfast and fruit bowls to hotel guests.
examples.zh: 這家豪華度假飯店為飯店住客提供免費精緻早餐與迎賓水果盤。

examples.en: A world-famous author appeared as the special guest speaker at the literary seminar.
examples.zh: 一位舉世聞名的作家作為特別受邀貴賓出席了這場文學研討會。

examples.en: Our neighbors are very friendly and always helpful.
examples.zh: 我們的鄰居非常親切而且總是樂於助人。

examples.en: Our next-door neighbor baked homemade banana bread and shared it with us.
examples.zh: 我們的隔壁鄰居烤了手工香蕉蛋糕並熱情與我們分享。

examples.en: Good community neighbors watch out for each other's home safety during holidays.
examples.zh: 良好的社區鄰里會在假期外出時互相守望相助照顧門戶安全。

examples.en: Never accept candy or rides from strangers.
examples.zh: 絕對不要接受陌生人給的糖果或搭便車。

examples.en: A courteous stranger kindly offered me umbrella shelter when it rained suddenly.
examples.zh: 突降陣雨時，一位彬彬有禮的陌生人好心地主動為我撐傘遮雨。

examples.en: Although we arrived as total strangers, we soon felt like close friends.
examples.zh: 儘管抵達時彼此完全是素未謀面的陌生人，我們很快就宛如熟稔的好友。

examples.en: A friend in need is a friend indeed.
examples.zh: 患難見真情。

examples.en: Joining campus clubs is a great way to make lifelong friends.
examples.zh: 參加校園社團是結交一生摯友的絕佳途徑。

examples.en: My best friend always listens patiently and offers thoughtful, honest advice.
examples.zh: 我最好的朋友總是耐心傾聽，並提供體貼而真摯坦率的建議。

examples.en: True friendship lasts through the years.
examples.zh: 真正的友誼歷久彌新。

examples.en: Distance and time cannot diminish the deep bond of genuine friendship.
examples.zh: 距離與歲月無法磨滅真正友誼之間深厚堅固的羈絆。

examples.en: We exchanged handwritten postcards to cultivate and cherish our international friendship.
examples.zh: 我們互相寄送手寫明信片，以維繫並珍惜這份跨越國界的深厚友誼。

examples.en: Can you give me some help with this suitcase?
examples.zh: 你能幫我提一下這個行李箱嗎？

examples.en: Volunteers offered valuable help at the community animal shelter.
examples.zh: 志工們在社區動物收容所提供了非常寶貴的協助。

examples.en: Do not hesitate to ask for help when facing overwhelming emotional stress.
examples.zh: 當面臨難以承受的心理壓力時，切莫猶豫尋求專業協助。

words.definition: 有幫助的；有益的；樂於助人的

examples.en: This English grammar chart is extremely helpful.
examples.zh: 這張英語文法圖表非常有幫助。

examples.en: The hotel concierge gave us helpful travel tips for navigating the historical city.
examples.zh: 飯店禮賓人員給了我們遊覽這座歷史名城非常實用的旅遊秘訣。

examples.en: He is a polite and helpful young man who always assists senior citizens.
examples.zh: 他是個有禮貌且熱心助人的年輕小伙子，總是主動攙扶協助長者。

examples.en: Sharing snacks with classmates creates happy memories.
examples.zh: 和同班同學分享零食能創造快樂回憶。

examples.en: She posted a blog entry to share her backpacking travel experiences in Europe.
examples.zh: 她發表了一篇部落格文章，分享她在歐洲背包自助旅行的寶貴經驗。

examples.en: The two leading smartphone brands hold the largest share of the domestic market.
examples.zh: 這兩大智慧型手機巨頭品牌佔據了國內市場最大的市佔份額。
